obligations.summary: Party A leases the specified workshop to Party B.
obligations.text: Party A leases the workshop (located at East Liuge Village, Weiwu Road, Bozhou, with the building area of 10000 square meters and usable area of 3000 square meters) to Party B.
evidenceSpans: Party A leases the workshop (located at East Liuge Village, Weiwu Road, Bozhou, with the building area of 10000 square meters and usable area of 3000 square meters) to Party B.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay Party A 100000 Yuan monthly before the 15th.
obligations.text: Party B shall pay 100000 Yuan to Party A before 15 of each month as the monthly rent.
evidenceSpans: Party B shall pay 100000 Yuan to Party A before 15 of each month as the monthly rent.

obligations.summary: Water and electricity fees must be settled separately; the responsible party is not specified.
obligations.text: The water & electricity fees shall be settled separately.
evidenceSpans: The water & electricity fees shall be settled separately.

obligations.summary: Party A is responsible for repairing the house.
obligations.text: Party A takes charge of repairing of the house.
evidenceSpans: Party A takes charge of repairing of the house.

obligations.summary: Party A must inspect the facilities.
obligations.text: Party A shall take the examination of the facilities
evidenceSpans: Party A shall take the examination of the facilities

obligations.summary: Party A must guarantee that the house has no leakage.
obligations.text: it shall guarantee that there is no leakage
evidenceSpans: it shall guarantee that there is no leakage

obligations.summary: Party A must guarantee good condition of the listed facilities for Party B's normal and safe use.
obligations.text: and the tap water, sewage and lighting, doors& windows are in good conditions, so as to ensure the normal and safe use of Party B.
evidenceSpans: and the tap water, sewage and lighting, doors& windows are in good conditions, so as to ensure the normal and safe use of Party B.

obligations.summary: Party A's repair scope and standard must follow the cited notice.
obligations.text: The repair scope and standard shall be performed by Urban Construction Department (87) C.Z.G.Z.No. 13 Notice.
evidenceSpans: The repair scope and standard shall be performed by Urban Construction Department (87) C.Z.G.Z.No. 13 Notice.

obligations.summary: Party B must assist Party A during house repairs.
obligations.text: Party B shall positively assist when Party A repairing the house.
evidenceSpans: Party B shall positively assist when Party A repairing the house.

obligations.summary: Following negotiation, Party A will fund repairs and organize construction within the maintenance scope.
obligations.text: Through the negotiation of the two parties, Party A will contribute for the repairing work and organize the construction according to the maintenance scope.
evidenceSpans: Through the negotiation of the two parties, Party A will contribute for the repairing work and organize the construction according to the maintenance scope.

obligations.summary: Party B must obtain Party A's approval of decoration details before construction.
obligations.text: the scale, scope, process and materials shall be approved by Party A, and then the construction work can be carried out.
evidenceSpans: the scale, scope, process and materials shall be approved by Party A, and then the construction work can be carried out.

obligations.summary: Party A must discuss decoration material fees and ownership after contract expiry.
obligations.text: The two parties shall discuss about the materials fees and ownership of the decoration objects after the contract expiring.
evidenceSpans: The two parties shall discuss about the materials fees and ownership of the decoration objects after the contract expiring.

obligations.summary: Party B must discuss decoration material fees and ownership after contract expiry.
obligations.text: The two parties shall discuss about the materials fees and ownership of the decoration objects after the contract expiring.
evidenceSpans: The two parties shall discuss about the materials fees and ownership of the decoration objects after the contract expiring.

obligations.summary: Party A must give Party B written notice three months before selling the house.
obligations.text: Party A shall notify Party B three months in advance of selling the house in the written form
evidenceSpans: Party A shall notify Party B three months in advance of selling the house in the written form
obligations.deadline: three months in advance of selling the house

obligations.summary: Party B must obtain Party A's approval if it intends to exchange the house.
obligations.text: Party B shall get the approval of Party A if it intends to exchange the house with others
evidenceSpans: Party B shall get the approval of Party A if it intends to exchange the house with others

obligations.summary: Party A must support Party B's reasonable demand in connection with an exchange.
obligations.text: Party A shall support the reasonable demand of Party B.
evidenceSpans: Party A shall support the reasonable demand of Party B.

obligations.summary: The party failing to comply with Article 4 must pay the other party 50000 Yuan; the breaching party is unspecified.
obligations.text: If one party doesn’t comply with the terms of Article 4, the party shall compensate 50000 Yuan for another party.
evidenceSpans: If one party doesn’t comply with the terms of Article 4, the party shall compensate 50000 Yuan for another party.

obligations.summary: Party A must handle the specified economic claims under the issuing organ's supervision.

obligations.summary: If termination results from the stated external causes, rent must reflect actual use and Party A must refund the difference.
obligations.text: If the contract is terminated owing to the above reasons, the rent will be calculated by the actual using time, and it will refund the difference.
evidenceSpans: If the contract is terminated owing to the above reasons, the rent will be calculated by the actual using time, and it will refund the difference.

obligations.summary: Party A must negotiate disputes arising from the contract.

obligations.summary: Party B must negotiate disputes arising from the contract.

rights.summary: Party A may stop Party B's independent transfer of the house to others.
